title: Back to the Dictionary Form
description: See a form, find the verb: the skill you need when reading and listening.

points.title: From て / た
points.summary: Back to the dictionary form: Reading or hearing a form, find the verb you'd look up.
points.body:
- **て / た**: って ← う・つ・る, んで ← ぬ・ぶ・む, いて ← く, いで ← ぐ, して ← す; a plain て after -i / -e → る-verb (+る).
- **ない**: あ-row + ない → う-row (帰らない → 帰る, 買わない → 買う); no あ-row → る-verb (着ない → 着る).
- **ます**: い-row + ます → う-row (書きます → 書く); otherwise る-verb (見ます → 見る).
- Irregular: きて / こない → 来る, して / しない → する.

questions.hint: んで ← ぬ, ぶ or む
questions.explanation: 読んで: んで ← ぬ, ぶ or む; with this kanji only 読む makes sense → **読む**.

questions.hint: って ← う, つ or る
questions.explanation: 買って: って ← う, つ or る; with this kanji only 買う makes sense → **買う**.

questions.hint: って ← う, つ or る
questions.explanation: 待った: って ← う, つ or る; with this kanji only 待つ makes sense → **待つ**.

questions.hint: って ← う, つ or る
questions.explanation: 帰って: って ← う, つ or る; with this kanji only 帰る makes sense → **帰る**. ⚠ An う-verb that looks like a る-verb.

questions.hint: Try a る-verb: is there a って / んで / いて?
questions.explanation: 着て: a plain て / た after an -i / -e sound: a る-verb, so add る → **着る**.

questions.hint: いて ← く
questions.explanation: 書いた: いて ← く; with this kanji only 書く makes sense → **書く**.

questions.hint: いで ← ぐ
questions.explanation: 急いで: いで ← ぐ; with this kanji only 急ぐ makes sense → **急ぐ**.

questions.hint: して ← す
questions.explanation: 話した: して ← す; with this kanji only 話す makes sense → **話す**.

questions.hint: んで ← ぬ, ぶ or む
questions.explanation: 遊んだ: んで ← ぬ, ぶ or む; with this kanji only 遊ぶ makes sense → **遊ぶ**.

questions.hint: って ← う, つ, る … or the exception 行く
questions.explanation: 行って: 行って is the one irregular て-form: 行く → **行く**.

questions.hint: Irregular: き・こ・く
questions.explanation: 来て: き / こ belong to the irregular 来る (きます, こない, きて) → **来る**.

questions.hint: ら is an あ-row sound
questions.explanation: 帰らない: ら (あ-row) + ない → back to the う-row: ら → る → **帰る**. ⚠ An う-verb that looks like a る-verb.

questions.hint: No あ-row sound before ない
questions.explanation: 着ない: nothing but ない was added, so it's a る-verb: ない → る → **着る**.

questions.hint: ら is an あ-row sound
questions.explanation: 知らない: ら (あ-row) + ない → back to the う-row: ら → る → **知る**. ⚠ An う-verb that looks like a る-verb.

questions.hint: わ is an あ-row sound
questions.explanation: 買わない: わ (あ-row) + ない → back to the う-row: わ → う → **買う**.

questions.hint: Irregular: き・こ・く
questions.explanation: 来ない: き / こ belong to the irregular 来る (きます, こない, きて) → **来る**.

questions.hint: -i sound before ます: る-verb (+る) or う-verb (i → u)?
questions.explanation: 見ます: an -i sound before ます can be a る-verb (+る) or an う-verb (い-row → う-row). You have to know the verb: here it's a る-verb, not 見む → **見る**.

questions.hint: -i sound before ます: る-verb (+る) or う-verb (i → u)?
questions.explanation: 書きます: an -i sound before ます can be a る-verb (+る) or an う-verb (い-row → う-row). You have to know the verb: here it's an う-verb, not 書きる → **書く**.

questions.hint: -i sound before ます: る-verb (+る) or う-verb (i → u)?
questions.explanation: 借ります: an -i sound before ます can be a る-verb (+る) or an う-verb (い-row → う-row). You have to know the verb: here it's a る-verb, not 借る → **借りる**.

questions.hint: -i sound before ます: る-verb (+る) or う-verb (i → u)?
questions.explanation: 入ります: an -i sound before ます can be a る-verb (+る) or an う-verb (い-row → う-row). You have to know the verb: here it's an う-verb, not 入りる → **入る**. ⚠ An う-verb that looks like a る-verb.
